description: Flying replica of the 1911 Blériot XI named Le Scarabée, registered C-ISCA. Not an original airframe. Confirmed on the museum's own aircraft page (September 2026); registration cross-read from the aviationmuseum.eu survey. The museum has been closed for major renovation since February 2026 and expects to reopen in late October 2026.
